title.narrative: Renewal and partnership, African region

description.narrative: Rroom is created new programmes arising out of the strategic cooperation between the Dutch Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Mondiaal FNV. The programme mainly focuses on Africa, and starting 2022 includes activities in Somalia , from 2023 onwards also Ghana and Nigeria, as well as several regional activities aimed at strengthening exchanges between countries for example regarding Just Transition or women leadership in trade unions.
